ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with a dominant distribution of high-intensity pixels (white) across the lobe interiors and low-intensity pixels (black) defining the trailing edges and focal markings; estimated 3:1 ratio of light to dark pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity zones occupy approximately 80% of the visible surface; low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary, the median notch area, and as focal spots/mottling across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth relative to the lobe peaks of roughly 40 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced jaggedness with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 15 pixels; left lobe shows more rhythmic, lower-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal curve; concave trajectory transitioning from the median notch moving outward, becoming slightly convex toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, irregular pixel aggregates (roughly circular/rough texture) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting calcified colonization or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-to-distal section of the right lobe surface, breaking the light-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the right lobe and irregular, jagged erosion of the trailing edge margins, particularly at the distal corners.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion at the fluke base (peduncle junction) caused by high-intensity pixel noise from water turbulence and splash.
